verses.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.pt: Para a liberdade Cristo nos libertou; permanecei, pois, firmes e não vos dobreis novamente a um jogo de escravidão.
verses.en_web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
verses.en_bbe: Christ has truly made us free: then keep your free condition and let no man put a yoke on you again.

verses.en: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.pt: Eis que eu, Paulo, vos digo que, se vos deixardes circuncidar, Cristo de nada vos aproveitará.
verses.en_web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.en_bbe: See, I Paul say to you, that if you undergo circumcision, Christ will be of no use to you.

verses.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.pt: E de novo testifico a todo homem que se deixa circuncidar, que está obrigado a guardar toda a lei.
verses.en_web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, I give witness again to every man who undergoes circumcision, that he will have to keep all the law.

verses.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.pt: Separados estais de Cristo, vós os que vos justificais pela lei; da graça decaístes.
verses.en_web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
verses.en_bbe: You are cut off from Christ, you who would have righteousness by the law; you are turned away from grace.

verses.en: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.pt: Nós, entretanto, pelo Espírito aguardamos a esperança da justiça que provém da fé.
verses.en_web: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: For we through the Spirit by faith are waiting for the hope of righteousness.

verses.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.pt: Porque em Cristo Jesus nem a circuncisão nem a incircuncisão vale coisa alguma; mas sim a fé que opera pelo amor.
verses.en_web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
verses.en_bbe: Because in Christ Jesus, having circumcision or not having circumcision are equally of no profit; but only faith working through love.

verses.en: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.pt: Corríeis bem; quem vos impediu de obedecer à verdade?
verses.en_web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
verses.en_bbe: You were going on well; who was the cause of your not giving ear to what is true?

verses.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.pt: Esta persuasão não vem daquele que vos chama.
verses.en_web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
verses.en_bbe: This ready belief did not come from him who had made you his.

verses.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.pt: Um pouco de fermento leveda a massa toda.
verses.en_web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
verses.en_bbe: A little leaven makes a change in all the mass.

verses.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.pt: Confio de vós, no Senhor, que de outro modo não haveis de pensar; mas aquele que vos perturba, seja quem for, sofrerá a condenação.
verses.en_web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
verses.en_bbe: I am certain about you in the Lord, that you will be of no other mind; but he who is troubling you will have his punishment, whoever he is.

verses.en: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, irmãos, se é que prego ainda a circuncisão, por que ainda sou perseguido? Nesse caso o escândalo da cruz estaria aniquilado.
verses.en_web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
verses.en_bbe: But I, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still attacked? then has the shame of the cross been taken away.

verses.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.pt: Oxalá se mutilassem aqueles que vos andam inquietando.
verses.en_web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
verses.en_bbe: My desire is that they who give you trouble might even be cut off themselves.

verses.en: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.pt: Porque vós, irmãos, fostes chamados à liberdade. Mas não useis da liberdade para dar ocasião à carne, antes pelo amor servi-vos uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
verses.en_bbe: Because you, brothers, were marked out to be free; only do not make use of your free condition to give the flesh its chance, but through love be servants one to another.

verses.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.pt: Pois toda a lei se cumpre numa só palavra, a saber: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.en_web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.en_bbe: For all the law is made complete in one word, even in this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

verses.en: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.pt: Se vós, porém, vos mordeis e devorais uns aos outros, vede não vos consumais uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
verses.en_bbe: But if you are given to fighting with one another, take care that you are not the cause of destruction one to another.

verses.en: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.pt: Digo, porém: Andai pelo Espírito, e não haveis de cumprir a cobiça da carne.
verses.en_web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
verses.en_bbe: But I say, Go on in the Spirit, and you will not come under the rule of the evil desires of the flesh.

verses.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.pt: Porque a carne luta contra o Espírito, e o Espírito contra a carne; e estes se opõem um ao outro, para que não façais o que quereis.
verses.en_web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
verses.en_bbe: For the flesh has desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; because these are opposite the one to the other; so that you may not do the things which you have a mind to do.

verses.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.pt: Mas, se sois guiados pelo Espírito, não estais debaixo da lei.
verses.en_web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.en_bbe: But if you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

verses.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.pt: Ora, as obras da carne são manifestas, as quais são: a prostituição, a impureza, a lascívia,
verses.en_web: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
verses.en_bbe: Now the works of the flesh are clear, which are these: evil desire, unclean things, wrong use of the senses,

verses.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.pt: a idolatria, a feitiçaria, as inimizades, as contendas, os ciúmes, as iras, as facções, as dissensões, os partidos,
verses.en_web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
verses.en_bbe: Worship of images, use of strange powers, hates, fighting, desire for what another has, angry feelings, attempts to get the better of others, divisions, false teachings,

verses.en: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: as invejas, as bebedices, as orgias, e coisas semelhantes a estas, contra as quais vos previno, como já antes vos preveni, que os que tais coisas praticam não herdarão o reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: Envy, uncontrolled drinking and feasting, and such things: of which I give you word clearly, even as I did in the past, that they who do such things will have no part in the kingdom of God.

verses.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.pt: Mas o fruto do Espírito é: o amor, o gozo, a paz, a longanimidade, a benignidade, a bondade, a fidelidade.
verses.en_web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
verses.en_bbe: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, a quiet mind, kind acts, well-doing, faith,

verses.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.pt: a mansidão, o domínio próprio; contra estas coisas não há lei.
verses.en_web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verses.en_bbe: Gentle behaviour, control over desires: against such there is no law.

verses.en: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.pt: E os que são de Cristo Jesus crucificaram a carne com as suas paixões e concupiscências.
verses.en_web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
verses.en_bbe: And those who are Christ's have put to death on the cross the flesh with its passions and its evil desires.

verses.en: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.pt: Se vivemos pelo Espírito, andemos também pelo Espírito.
verses.en_web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: If we are living by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us be guided.

verses.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.pt: Não nos tornemos vangloriosos, provocando-nos uns aos outros, invejando-nos uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
verses.en_bbe: Let us not be full of self-glory, making one another angry, having envy of one another.
